training_stack: mjlab 1.3.0 (MuJoCo Warp), PPO via RSL-RL, trained with pollen-robotics/microduck_rl

contract.obs_layout: ang_vel 0:3, projected_gravity 3:6, joint_pos_rel 6:20, joint_vel 20:34, last_action 34:48, command 48:61 (twist 3 + head_pose 4 + body_pose 6)
contract.obs_normalization: empirical normalizer BAKED INTO the ONNX (exported with microduck_rl scripts/export.py) -- feed raw observations
contract.gravity_input: projected gravity (infer_policy.py CLI default), NOT the raw accelerometer

lineage.stand_teacher: own StandUp expert with support-contact gate, logs/rsl_rl/microduck_stand/2026-10-29_20-14-19_supportgate/model_3500.pt
lineage.chunk_1: 4,000 iterations warm-started from the walk (MICRODUCK_WARM_START=1), 2,048 envs -> model_3000
lineage.round_2: 4,000 iterations, plain resume from model_3000 (3000 -> 6999), 2,048 envs, walk anchor fed an x/y/yaw command lookup table (LOCAL_ANCHOR_TWIST_REMAP, distill.remap_anchor_twist) -> model_6750 chosen
lineage.code: github.com/dillonfaulk/microduck_rl, branch local/velstand-own-teachers (commits 6bc72eba code, f19c6ae8 runs/scripts), based on pollen-robotics/microduck_rl b02fdea

drive: cd microduck_rl && uv run python scripts/infer_policy.py --new-cmd-obs --scene src/mjlab_microduck/robot/microduck/scene_allcollisions.xml --walking <onnx>. Do NOT use logs/drive_remap.py with model_6750 (it was calibrated for model_3000 and overshoots now).

measured_results_model_6750.cpu_sim: fixed harness (BAM actuator, 1-step delay, training solver, allcollisions scene): get-ups 46/48 fallen starts (face-down 8/8, face-up 8/8, left side 8/8, right side 8/8, sitting 6/8); no falls in any walking test; fwd 0.15 -> 0.15 m/s, fwd 0.30 -> 0.26, back 0.20 -> 0.12, turn +-1.0 -> 1.09 / -1.08 rad/s, turn left 0.5 -> 0.57
measured_results_model_6750.training_sim: get-ups 99.0% / 99.5% (prone, 1024 envs, 20 s); knocked over while walking -> back up 95.3%; forward tracking near-exact 0.1-0.25 m/s

known_weaknesses: SIM ONLY -- never run on the physical robot
get-ups are violent: ~14 rad/s peak trunk angular velocity (inherited from the stand teacher); must soften before hardware
0.1 m/s forward/backward from standstill does nothing (CPU sim)
slow right turn in place (0.5 rad/s) does nothing; left works
backing up curves (~0.2 rad/s at 0.2 m/s back)
strafe capped ~0.08 m/s by the walk teacher
